# Architecture Diagram

> Generated by the `assessment-diagram` skill for **ibatis2MybatisTools** (Java 8, Maven)

## Overview

`ibatis2MybatisTools` is a standalone Java command-line tool that automates migration of iBATIS 2 artefacts (DAO implementation files and XML configuration/mapper files) to MyBatis 3 format. It has no web layer, no database connections, and no external service dependencies.

## Architecture Diagram

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph Input["Input Sources (Local File System)"]
        A1[iBATIS DAO Impl Files\n.java files]
        A2[sqlMapConfig XML Files\niBATIS config XML]
        A3[sqlMap XML Files\niBATIS mapper XML]
    end

    subgraph Tool["ibatis2MybatisTools - Java 8 CLI Application"]
        B1[main entry point\nIbatis2Mybatus.main]
        B2[convertDaoImpl\nRegex text replacement]
        B3[convertConfigXML\nXML structure migration]
        B4[convertSqlMapXML\nXML mapper migration]
        B5[XML Processing Layer\ndom4j 2.1.3\nSAXReader, XMLWriter]
        B6[Regex Engine\njava.util.regex\nPattern, Matcher]
    end

    subgraph Output["Output - Migrated Files (in place)"]
        C1[MyBatis 3 DAO Impl Files\n.java files updated]
        C2[mybatis-config XML Files\nMyBatis 3 config format]
        C3[MyBatis 3 Mapper XML Files\nMyBatis 3 mapper format]
    end

    A1 --> B2
    A2 --> B3
    A3 --> B4
    B1 --> B2
    B1 --> B3
    B1 --> B4
    B2 --> B6
    B3 --> B5
    B4 --> B5
    B4 --> B6
    B2 --> C1
    B3 --> C2
    B4 --> C3
```

## Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology | Version |
|-------|-----------|---------|
| Language | Java | 8 (source/target) |
| Build | Maven | 3.x |
| XML Parsing | dom4j | 2.1.3 |
| Regex Engine | java.util.regex | JDK built-in |
| File I/O | java.io | JDK built-in |
| Logging | System.out.println | (no framework) |

## Key Observations

- **No web/server layer**: Pure CLI tool invoked via `main()`
- **No database**: Reads and writes local files only
- **No external services**: Self-contained with a single third-party library (dom4j)
- **In-place transformation**: Output files overwrite the input files
- **Stateless**: No persistent state between runs
